entries.title: DARPA Collaborates with Commercial Partners to Accelerate Quantum Computing
entries.note: US2QC initial selection: Atom Computing, Microsoft, PsiQuantum.

entries.title: DARPA selects two discrete utility-scale quantum computing approaches for evaluation
entries.note: Microsoft and PsiQuantum selected for US2QC validation/co-design phase; ~50-expert evaluation team described.

entries.title: DARPA eyes companies targeting industrially useful quantum computers
entries.note: QBI Stage A entrants and six-month characterization sprint description.

entries.title: Stage B selection | Quantum Benchmarking Initiative
entries.note: Eleven Stage B companies; Stage B is yearlong R&D-plan and risk-reduction evaluation, not a technology verdict.

entries.title: Quantum Motion Delivers the Industry's First Full-Stack Silicon CMOS Quantum Computer
entries.note: Company announcement; includes a corroborating quote from NQCC director Michael Cuthbert.

entries.title: Quantum Motion Delivers the Industry's First Full-Stack Silicon CMOS Quantum Computer
entries.note: Independent trade-press coverage of the same event; derived largely from the company release — counts as one corroborating family, not an independent measurement.

entries.title: Quantum Motion Selected by DARPA to Advance to Second Phase of the Quantum Benchmarking Initiative Project
entries.note: Company framing of the Stage B selection; DARPA page is the authoritative record.

entries.title: Quantum Motion Raises £42 Million Investment Round Led By Bosch Ventures
entries.note: Funding claim — capital is not technical validation.

entries.title: Spinout raises £42 million to develop quantum processors
entries.note: Founding university coverage; records founding year 2017 and founders Morton (UCL) and Benjamin (Oxford).

entries.title: Low charge noise quantum dots with industrial CMOS manufacturing
entries.note: Peer-reviewed. Record-low average charge noise 0.61 µeV·Hz^-1/2 at 1 Hz on a customized 300 mm Si MOS line.

entries.title: Qubits made by advanced semiconductor manufacturing
entries.note: Zwerver et al., QuTech/Intel: 300 mm fab spin qubits (Si/SiGe). Architecture-level evidence for silicon-spin manufacturability; NOT a Quantum Motion result.

entries.title: Research — Quantum Motion
entries.note: Company research feed: 8 µs readout method and exchange-control demonstration in a 300 mm MOS double quantum dot.

entries.title: PsiQuantum Announces Omega, a Manufacturable Chipset for Photonic Quantum Computing
entries.note: Announces Omega chipset; GlobalFoundries manufacturing; Brisbane and Chicago Quantum Compute Centers.

entries.title: A manufacturable platform for photonic quantum computing
entries.note: Peer-reviewed Omega component benchmarks: 99.98% SPAM, 99.22% fusion, 99.72% chip-to-chip — all conditional on photon detection, not accounting for loss.

entries.title: DARPA Selects PsiQuantum to Advance to Final Phase of Quantum Computing Program
entries.note: Company account of US2QC final-phase entry; SLAC cryogenic module and Milpitas facility described.

entries.title: PsiQuantum Signs $125 Million Agreement with DARPA
entries.note: Expanded QBI Stage C agreement; records Sep 2025 $31.8M tasking. A contract value, not a technical result.

entries.title: Quantum computing testbeds
entries.note: Seven testbed providers and project names, including Quantum Motion's Silicon Cloverleaf.

entries.title: UKRI and NQCC invest £30 million in UK quantum innovators
entries.note: Seven testbed awards: Aegiq, Cold Quanta UK (Infleqtion), ORCA, Oxford Ionics, Rigetti UK, Quantum Motion, QuEra. Deploy by March 2025.

entries.title: Metriq — open quantum benchmark results
entries.note: Community benchmark repository; observes published results comparability across platforms.

entries.title: Quantum Economic Development Consortium
entries.note: Industry consortium; observes supply-chain maturity, benchmarking taxonomy, workforce. Membership is not technical validation.

entries.title: NPL quantum metrology
entries.note: National metrology institute; observes measurement standards and independent characterisation capability.

entries.title: EuroHPC JU quantum computing
entries.note: Procures and hosts European quantum systems (EuroQCS); procurement is a demand signal, not a technical verdict.

entries.title: PsiQuantum cryogenic module at SLAC
entries.note: Company-described installation at DOE's SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory; DOE confirmation not separately captured in Genesis.
